p.d: Were just like New York, they say of their city, and usually add: Only nicer! Toronto is a melting pot of diverse cultures. Most of its residents have immigrated, at some point.

On September 11th, 2001, four hijacked airplanes struck the heart of America. At 8:46 am, New York time, the first airplane crashed into the World Trade Centre -- an attack whose global consequences still reverberate to this day.
Athletes in the Baltic states are combining elite sports with military service as Russias war in Ukraine reshapes regional security. The line between competitor and defender is increasingly blurred.
An increasing number of people dont want to be cremated or buried after their death. They want their bodies to return to the earth as fertile soil. This poses both an ethical and a legal challenge.

Is Punk really dead? Not even close. Fifty years after the Sex Pistols, Ramones, Patti Smith and Nina Hagen helped launch a global movement, Punk is still shaping music, culture and politics around the world. DW reporter Annika Sost explores Berlins legendary punk scene to find out why Punk continues to inspire new generations.

Legacy automakers are facing multiple crises at once. Could that be a chance to reinvent themselves and the car itself? Will your next ride be solar-powered? And: Meet two sisters who brave the streets of Lagos on bikes.
In Norway, visionary architect Kjetil Thorsen is redefining the way we think about buildings and architecture with an Opera House that you can walk on and a restaurant that plunges into the sea.
A true hidden gem of South Africa, the Garden Route is a 200km stretch of coastal highway known for its beguiling diversity and unparalleled spirit of wilderness.

Warren has arrived into Cape Town. This won’t be your average culinary exploration of a city; Warren has dedicated the entire episode to diving into a specific style of South African cooking known as 『Cape Malay』.
Warren is in the Franschhoek Valley, exploring the endless bounty of Boschendal Wine Estate.
Continuing to listen to his heart, Warren deepens his love of wine by venturing to the lesser known town of Hermanus, where he』ll visit Newton Johnson, the 『wine farm with a view』.

Warren is heading out of Cape Town into the more quiet coastal area of the Western Cape, and the picturesque town of Paternoster. It’s here he』ll marvel at the seaside village feel and take an e-bike ride along the beach.
As the final stanza in Warren’s Food Trail of South Africa, he’s back in the bush, a quintessential part of all travel to the rainbow nation.

p.t: Around The World With Manu Feildel #1
p.d: Manu Feildel has a dream to follow in the footsteps of Jules Vernes』 Around the World in 80 days. So Manu sets himself a challenge to circumnavigate the world, through his food loving eyes. Will he make it? First stop - London.

p.t: Around The World With Manu Feildel #2
p.d: Manu arrives in Dubai after London and is quick to dig up as much culinary experience in Dubai so he sets off to the spice souk, fish markets and a local pastry kitchen.

p.t: Around The World With Manu Feildel #3
p.d: Manu is in India for the first time in his life and wants to discover as much food as he can handle. From an Idli making lesson to a workout in the flower markets of Kolkata. Will he make it to Hong Kong on time and in one piece?

There are few players who capture the imagination of fans worldwide quite like Kylian Mbappé. In just over a decade, he went from absolute obscurity to becoming one of the most famous players in the world.
This documentary offers an intimate and comprehensive journey through the extraordinary career of Lionel Messi - from his humble beginnings in Rosario, Argentina, to becoming a global football icon.
Clint Eastwood, Actor, director and philanthropist. From being the quintessential western icon, to honing his artistic skills and caring persona. This is his magnificent story.
See how the British bomber Lancaster flew out of the factory and into action, leading devastating attacks on Germany.
Discover how and why the fighter-bomber Panavia Tornado has been so useful in so many roles for so many years.

p.d: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

In Zhou dynasty, two girls living in two ends of the Luo He River come from diverse backgrounds - one is a captains daughter and another is a common swindler - and they encounter a series of mysterious events in Luo Yang City. Both team up to investigate a series of bizarre cases, to uphold justice and to maintain order amidst a social upheaval.

Asias biggest human trafficker Ba Song, invites the triad bosses to attend his private party. Ya Mei sneaks in and helps her teammates to escape by setting off a bomb, at the same time faking the death of herself and her fiancée. Three years later, Mei must resume duty to fight against Ba Song in order to save her kidnapped fiancée.

Tian Yi is destined to fail as an immortal in heaven. When he accidentally frees Snowy and makes her a demon, he wanders in hell for thousand years to right his wrong. After a series of hardships, Snowy and Tian Yi manages to get married, but the heavenly warriors attempt to arrest Snowy. Can the couple live happily ever after?

Released from jail after an alleged offence, Lao Duan plans a scam to uncover the truth behind the past happenings. His three kids, each of distinct character, get involved in the plan. The family join hands to defeat the enemy, but at the same time, also making troubles for themselves. As the situation spirals, the ending ia anyones guess.

Set in the Tang dynasty, a fallen demon dragon causes the people of Qujiang City to mysteriously go bald overnight. Outraged, the Emperor assigns Magistrate Wang to investigate the case. Wang infiltrates the secret Long Wang Cult and exposes their plot to instigate a massacre, eventually saving the emperor and protecting the people.

During the Qing Dynasty, two magistrates died from a deadly snake bite, causing fear amongst the people. When two imperial constables investigate the case, they discover that a Happiness drug is commonly abused in town. Despite facing many difficulties during the investigation, they strive to bring the mastermind to justice.

A group of criminals joins the Disciple gang to engage in drug trafficking, smuggling and assault in Pu Guang City. One day, the police receives information from an undercover of the gang, and Inspector Tang is assigned to lead a thorough investigation. They must disintegrate the gang in 72 hours for the peace and harmony of Pu Guang City.

After hiding in Mount Zhang for seven years, Zhao Zi Long reunites with Liu Bei and Zhao Yun. Persuaded by Lius righteousness, Zhao rediscovers his aspirations and rallies his comrades to battle their enemies at Chang Ban Slope. He eventually defeats the enemies and emerges as the Great General of the Han Dynasty.

Young blacksmith Lui encounters his idol, Swordsman Bai Li, and helps Bai deport He Qing Ying, a lackey of the emperors secret agency. However, He claims that she is innocent while Bai Li is the one who has betrayed the patriots. Things become suspicious and Lui is unsure of whom to trust. Who will he trust in the end?

p.t: Seventeen and a Half Years Old
p.d: Zhang Jun Jia directs a micro movie starring the school girl he likes. As Arts festival approaches, Zhang and his classmates decide to make a college zombie movie. They encounter many difficulties in the process and despite the production team falling into pieces, they manage to overcome the challenges with love amongst friends, family and lovers.

A fatal pursuit happens in a no mans land. Young Jin Yan accidentally captures the scene of a poacher attacking a cop, and the villains attack and injure him when they discover his act. As Jin tries to escape, they kidnap his sister as well. Jin and his sister must strive to escape from the villains and bring them to justice.

Agent Tang is trained by the secret society to work undercover in the imperial government. Tang wants to quit for a peaceful life with her husband but is forced to kill the Imperial Prince when the society holds her husband hostage. Tang resolves to break free and joins forces with the Imperial Prince to destroy the society and restore peace.

When Chen Zhen travels to Japan to learn industrial technology, he teams up with martial artist She Zi Li, and accepts a duel challenge from the Japanese military officials to uphold the Chinese dignity. In a battle of Chinese kung fu master agianst the Japanese samurai, Chen showcases the unique finesse of Chinese kung fu.

Shao Nan is proud of his brother Shao Bai being the combat fighting champion. When Shao Bei died after being seriously injured in a fight, the founder of the fight company decides to train Shao Nan for vengeance. Shao Nan eventually rises to become the next champion, fulfilling his brothers last wish and make Asians proud.
Sylvester Stallone stars in Daylight as a fallen hero racing to rescue commuters trapped in a collapsing NYC tunnel. Explosive action and suspense power this high-stakes disaster thriller!

Martial artists join Red Lotus Flower Society to overthrow evil emperor. Governor hunts society members. Kung fu practitioner falls for merchants daughter amid kung fu contest for her hand. Gender role reversal comedy ensues.

p.d: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

A struggling writer retreats to his childhood home to finish a novel and save his career. There, he uncovers the final manuscript left behind by his father, a famous writer who died mysteriously years earlier. Realizing the work is beyond his own talent, he decides to plagiarize it, unleashing horrifying supernatural events.

Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

A woman in hospital accidentally discovers her husband’s affair. On the verge of breakdown, she begins to encounter a “stranger” who claims to also be a victim of the affair. Is this entity a figment of her imagination or a vengeful spirit? As she struggles to control her thoughts and actions, can she stop herself from hurting those around her?

A year after Jamies wife tragically died in a car accident, he persuades her sister, Ava, to accompany him to the accident site to perform a peculiar ritual. As the night progresses, it becomes evident that Jamie harbours sinister motives.

A group of friends invites Paul to a secret party on their campus rooftop. When a prank accidentally kills Paul, the friends cover up the incident and promised never to disclose it. Paul vows to take revenge by becoming a vicious ghost to haunt them into taking responsibility for their actions.

Renowned as the corpse whisperer, forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

Thirteen years after an explosion in an abandoned building killed their friend Noo Aon, Tong and his group return to the site—now their university campus. When a girl who looks exactly like Noo Aon appears, a childhood game turns into a lethal ritual. One by one, the friends are hunted by a vengeful spirit determined to settle a long-overdue score.
